explication: syntaqlite provides SQLite SQL parsing, formatting, schema-aware analysis, and language-server features through a CLI, editor integrations, and language libraries. The main workflow is SQL input followed by parsing and then formatting, analysis, or editor services; the README documents these capabilities, while the sampled source shows parser and analysis internals. It also documents browser playground and multi-language library access. Internal links are limited to relationships supported by the README or source index; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
